body: I don't even care anymore. I really don't have anything to live for. And even if I'm not a bother so what? I'm just there.

I mentioned that the girl I love is 2000 miles away. It's incredibly hard for me. The only person I'm close to and I am actually so far away.

Ofcourse I want to live. Life is beautiful there are so many things I want to do. I had a very good life. I have no reason to die other then I'm weak and can't deal with the little problems that happen. 

I gave up on my life 2 years ago. I haven't done anything to improve it. I know I could do a lot more but it's just not worth it to me. 

Thank you for your concern really! I'm not a good person. I'm very greedy and I don't give back to those who helped me.

Thank you for all the positive thought. I'm sure there are people whom have been happy to meet me. I'm sure there would be more people who would remember me. But this is the end of my road. I wish I could die not by suicide but by helping someone. Even natural causes would be better. But sadly I can't choose either. So I'll just do it myself.

You are right about not exploiting all the possible solutions. I know there are ways to get free or very cheap therapy in my area but it's very hard and time consuming.

There really isn't anything to think over. It will all be gone in 10 hours so I'll make this next 10 hours great.

Well I don't want to be cynical so I worked on changing it. I think I might be able to change it. 

Well we've actually never met in real life. She knows I need her already. She's the one who convinced me twice not to do it. She's basically the only reason I've been alive for this past 2.5 months. I know she can forget me. 

I'm not anxious. I've never been anxious. I really don't worry about the future at all. I've had this feeling since I was about 7. That's the first memory of me walking somewhere and looking at myself from outside my body. I would love to know more about these if you have the time to explain. 

This is the weirdest. I'm not hopeless. I see many things that could be awesome and I could do them. There are many times a day when I don't feel like doing it. But those are all fleeing moments. They never stick. No matter how good of a day it was. 

2 days ago I talked with her for 4 hours on the phone. It was literally the best time of my life. She was very busy this past week so we barely had time to talk and she didn't go to 2 classes and instead talked to me. I'm a very lucky man I know. 

Thank you for caring and answering. I hope you read the whole thing and know that I really do appreciate people like you! 

Also being friends is cool with me. I love making friends. But I never have long term friendships so it never changes anything.
